title: Minimum Wage Hike Linked to Rise in Robot Adoption
discussion_signal: The post presents evidence that higher wage floors are associated with more industrial-robot adoption, especially near state borders. Replies add a counter-signal about firm selection and broader capital-cycle conditions, while the discussion explicitly separates technology adoption from unknown worker outcomes.
linked_research_question: How do wage floors change firm technology choices, and when does automation alter worker outcomes rather than only production methods?
limits: The social post summarizes a research paper rather than reproducing its identification strategy
Robot adoption is not the same as job loss
Discussion of general robots extends beyond the study's observed setting
